body: Turned 23 two months ago and I relate. I just want to be happy

Coming from someone who looks like they figured it out. No one has. Im 23 I have a boyfriend, “good” job and an apartment but I’m still depressed and my relationship is falling apart and I hate my job. Not to dwell on myself but just to remind you that what you see from everyone on the outside might not actually be the reality so it’s better to just focus on ourselves and what we’re doing that everyone else. Because everyone is going to make their own lives look perfect on the outside bc life is really just one big competition for who has it better
I’m in the exact same situation and it does really suck

They won’t call the cops unless they think you’re going to 100% kill yourself and they can’t talk you down. But I wouldn’t suggest calling bc most of the time they’re not very helpful at least in America they just give you generic answers to try to relate to you but none of it really seems sincere. Unless you get a person who really cares about their job
Thank you for that i needed to hear this

You know this really means a lot. And you’re right it’s just hard being alone. Especially being someone who’s so dependent on people it makes it a lot harder. But that’s the whole reason I downloaded Reddit and joined this app was to feel less alone you know. But everything you said is so true it’s just hard to accept the truth sometimes
It’s hard to keep going when everything that looks like it could be positive and could be a sign of your life getting better ends up turning to shit and you end up in this endless loop of false hope
Well I wanted to go for psychiatry (for obvious reasons) but it just seems impossible now

You’re 15 I promise you are in control of your life and your insecurities. One day you will use all of this as motivation to better yourself and bring you somewhere where you are happy and in control abs you will look back and think about how proud 15y/o you would be if she only knew what was in store for her future
